scope: Last Stand's enemies (and survival/enemies/tribunal-guard.glb, which only Last Stand fields). every entry marked original is the game's own.

assets.name: Tribunal Guard

source.title: Tribunal Guard (an original made for the game)
source.author: made for the game
source.license: Original asset made for the game

body.model: Tripo image-to-3D v3.1, detailed geometry and texture

provenance.skeleton: the horde's shared humanoid skeleton (24 joints) at the rest rotations of the file it replaces
provenance.motion: the horde's shared motion library (the game's own, made with Meshy), under the clip names its kit asks for (`_combo_b`...; no ripped motion)

assets.modifications: Decimated to the horde budget, one 1024 px base-colour atlas, limbs swung onto the skeleton's T-pose, skin carried onto the shared skeleton's joints (four weights a vertex).
